description: Exclusively launched on AtlantisChain — the world’s ONLY ultra-super-fast Layer-0 blockchain with 3,600,000 TPS and 0.031-second block time — Bitcoin Pizza (PZA) commemorates May 22, 2010, when Laszlo Hanyecz spent 10,000 BTC on 2 pizzas, marking the 1st real-world Bitcoin purchase. By symbolizing the most expensive pizzas, PZA empowers its holders, traders, and users with instant finality, ultra-low gas fees, and AI contract capabilities, delivering a meme-inspired digital asset worldwide.
name: Bitcoin Pizza
